verifies.G036-C2: the parent-interface choice of the single-entity repository window lists a generic project repository interface (BaseRepository<T, ID> extends JpaRepository<T, ID>, written by setup in another package) next to the Spring Data parents, and the created repository extends it with the entity and ID types and imports it. Only generic interfaces with two type parameters that extend a Spring Data repository are offered, so a concrete project repository (ProductRepository) is not: a non-generic repository cannot take an entity type. Parent interfaces that only a build dependency provides are not discovered.
